description: Python library and MCP server implementing 124+ intangible asset valuation formulas (relief from royalty, MPEEM, cost/market/income approaches, purchase price allocation, goodwill impairment, IP, technology, customer and workforce assets, Monte Carlo) as 14 read-only MCP tools for ASC 805 / IFRS 3 / IFRS 13 workflows.
rules: Install with `pip install 'intangible-valuation[mcp]'`; run the stdio server with `intangible-valuation-mcp` or `uvx --from intangible-valuation intangible-valuation-mcp`.
The hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint is https://intangible-valuation.simonmak.com/api/mcp.
All 14 MCP tools (`valuation_*`) are deterministic, read-only calculators; they never fetch market data, so supply every input explicitly.
Prefer the dedicated asset tools (`valuation_ip`, `valuation_technology`, `valuation_customer`) over the generic `valuation_income_methods` when the asset class is known.
Use `valuation_goodwill_ppa` for purchase price allocation and `valuation_impairment` for goodwill/intangible impairment testing.
